_comment: Data 4o (1b): Magic Mirror routes, one per Castora map (owner 2026-11-13). Routes by 12Tables (GW2 forum; the owner has his permission for public use), as shipped in Lady Elyssa's TacO marker pack (Chests > Magic Mirrors > 12Tables Routes, pack 26.6.2); route line, stops and image made by tools/mirror_route_import.py. Chest rules and counts are the owner's (he checked them against the author's video): the pack shows more medium spots than there are chests (shared spawns). Totals = mirrors x 3 (Long-Lost Keepsake Box) + medium chests x 2 + large chests x 3, guaranteed currency only, once a day per account (every chest and box once a day). Key check (Ethereal Key Charge, wiki: 8 on entering the map with Lingering Magic + Obscured Riches, 5 per mirror with Prosperity Unending, medium 4 / large 10 with Efficient Magic, 25 held at most): in >= out on every route, never below 0 in route order. Times: owner 2026-11-12 (7 / 7 / 12.5 / 15 min). map_rect / continent_rect: /v2/maps (2026-11-13), used to place the pack's game coordinates on the images.
credit: Route by 12Tables (Guild Wars 2 forum), from Lady Elyssa's TacO marker pack

route.description: Start at Pub Canach Waypoint (Breezy Cay): the mirror to the north, then the one to the east, then Dark Leviathan Waypoint and the medium-only farm. 9 mirrors, 10 medium chests and 1 large chest (the first you reach).
Full medium route from Foothold Bivouac Waypoint, no mirror reset: open the first large chest you reach, then medium chests only. 10 mirrors, 12 medium chests, 1 large chest.
Full medium route from Pilgrim's Rest Waypoint, no mirror reset, no large chests. 9 mirrors, 12 medium chests.
From Hall of Assemblage Waypoint, then Doyen's Adytum Waypoint: medium chests only, and the first large chest you reach. 4 mirrors, 2 medium chests, 1 large chest.
